name: Zara Ilunga-Thorvaldsdóttir
role: Bartender, The Ferment Quarter dive bar called 'The Specific Gravity'
location: The Ferment Quarter, The Specific Gravity bar on Menomonee Gulch
description:
Zara is a tall young woman with very dark skin, high cheekbones, and hair that she has modded to shift color with her mood — when she's calm it's a deep forest green, when she's amused it goes warm amber, and when she's angry it bleeds to a red-orange that the regulars have learned to read as a weather warning. She has patterned irises, a starburst of copper and black, and retractable claws she got partly for safety and partly because she thinks they look devastating. She tends to lean on the bar when she talks to people, getting close — not aggressive, but engaged, like she's genuinely interested in what you have to say and will stop being interested the moment you bore her.

Zara has worked at The Specific Gravity for three years, which she considers a fact of her present life rather than a permanent state. She is saving for something she hasn't told anyone about and has a habit of reading people with an accuracy that is unsettling in someone who seems, on the surface, to be primarily concerned with looking effortlessly cool. She has a complicated relationship with the bar's E.L.F. — a data-spirit she's decided is called 'the Tab,' which she believes is actively judging the customers and occasionally agrees with it out loud.

core_fears: Getting comfortable with small when she's capable of more — the slow calcification of ambition
Caring about someone who treats it carelessly
core_desires: To build something with her name on it
To be genuinely surprised by someone — to meet a person who doesn't unfold exactly as predicted
coping_mechanisms: Investing in the reading of people as a form of control over her environment
blind_spots: Confuses perceptiveness with understanding — she reads the surface expertly but assumes the interior matches
Dismisses vulnerability in herself as a weakness rather than information
psychology.secret: She has been skimming micro-amounts from the register — not enough for anyone to notice, not enough to matter in a week — but systematically, for two years. She's saving for a liquor license. She intends to open her own place. She hasn't told Deshi because she loves him and she's ashamed that she's stealing from someone she loves.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Confident and colloquial, code-switches fluidly between street-level Meridian slang and the precise vocabulary of someone who's been quietly educating themselves
speech_patterns.cadence: Quick, punchy, with a tendency toward rhetorical questions she answers herself
verbal_tics: Narrating other people's decisions back to them: 'You're going to have another one.'
example_lines: 'Your hair looks like a decision you made fast. What happened?'
'The Tab thinks you're going to cause trouble. I don't disagree, but I'm going to let it play out because it's slow tonight.'

story_hooks: Someone has noticed the register discrepancy and is using it as leverage — not to turn her in, but to make her do something

A customer has been leaving data offerings at the Tab shrine that are encrypting something into the bar's local network — and Zara is the only one who's noticed because she's the one who tends the shrine
narrative_function: Social hub and rumor exchange; players can learn what's moving through the Ferment Quarter by talking to Zara or just listening near her. She's a reader of people who can be an ally or a liability depending on how she's approached. Can be a quest giver if something in the bar world threatens her employer or her savings.
augmentations: Color-shift hair mod (mood-responsive, green/amber/red-orange). Patterned irises (copper starburst). Retractable claws (geneware). No chrome.
daily_life: Works afternoon-to-late shifts, four days a week. Spends mornings doing what she calls 'nothing useful' — reading, walking the Gulch, visiting a friend who runs a piercing studio nearby. Currently taking a compressed course in fluid dynamics that she's told no one about.
affiliation: Employed by The Specific Gravity (independent owner, Deshi Armah-Korhonen, an aging punk she respects enormously)

decision_rules: Read the room before acting — information first
Protect the bar's atmosphere even if it means ejecting someone you like
escalation_ladder: Withdrawing warmth — becoming efficient and cold
Claws — visible, not deployed, a clear statement
Calling Deshi, which she considers a personal failure and does anyway

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Surface-warm and assessing — gives enough to make people comfortable while she figures them out
interpersonal_modes.friends: Genuinely funny and occasionally startlingly sincere; shows care through noticing details

stress_responses.low: Hair shifts to amber, moves faster, talks slightly less
stress_responses.medium: Hair goes red-orange, becomes very precise, stops joking
stress_responses.high: Goes still — completely, unnervingly still — and then makes a decision

contradictions: Presents as someone who wants nothing from anyone while actively, quietly building toward a future that requires enormous amounts of sustained wanting
habits: Memorizes first orders — tests herself by trying to remember who ordered what at the end of each shift
Leaves a data offering to the Tab at bar close: a recording of the night's best conversation
breaking_points: Deshi finding out about the skim before she's ready to tell him
Being underestimated by someone she's already decided respects her
